title: Archive Spell 1: Importing modules
lessonSummary: Great! You fetch ready-made tools with import, as and from.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: three ways to import math.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import math
import math as m
from math import sqrt
print(f"Whole: {math.sqrt(16)}")
print(f"Nickname: {m.sqrt(25)}")
print(f"Single: {sqrt(36)}")

tasks.instruction: Import math with the nickname m and print exactly Root: 7.0 by using m.sqrt(49).
Fetch only ceil and floor with from math import. Print exactly Rounded up: 4 (for 3.2) and on the next line Rounded down: 3 (for 3.8).

title: Archive Spell 2: Random numbers
lessonSummary: Nice! You roll dice with random and make chance repeatable.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: randint, uniform and seed.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import random
wurf = random.randint(1, 6)
print(f"Roll in range: {1 <= wurf <= 6}")
komma = random.uniform(10, 20)
print(f"Decimal in range: {10 <= komma <= 20}")
random.seed(7)
a = random.randint(1, 100)
random.seed(7)
b = random.randint(1, 100)
print(f"Seed works: {a == b}")

tasks.instruction: Roll random.randint(1, 6) twenty times in a for loop. Set all_ok = True at the start and to False as soon as a roll is not between 1 and 6. Then print exactly All in range: True.
Set random.seed(5), draw first = random.randint(1, 100), set random.seed(5) once more and draw second = random.randint(1, 100). Print exactly Same: True (first == second).

title: Archive Spell 3: Choosing and shuffling at random
lessonSummary: Great! You choose, draw and shuffle entries at random.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: choice, sample and shuffle with property checks.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import random
shelves = ["Shelf of Elements", "Shelf of Animals", "Shelf of Stars", "Shelf of Shadows", "Shelf of Heroes"]
eins = random.choice(shelves)
print(f"Chosen is in the list: {eins in shelves}")
drei = random.sample(shelves, 3)
print(f"Different drawn: {len(set(drei))}")
mischung = shelves.copy()
random.shuffle(mischung)
print(f"Same entries: {sorted(mischung) == sorted(shelves)}")

tasks.instruction: The list shelves is provided. Choose an entry with random.choice() and print exactly Contained: True (chosen in shelves).

title: Archive Spell 4: The string module

print(f"Key length: {len(schluessel)}")

title: Archive Spell 5: Time with time and datetime
lessonSummary: Nice! You wait, measure time and read the clock.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: waiting, measuring time and reading the clock.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import time
from datetime import datetime
start = time.time()
time.sleep(0.1)
ende = time.time()
print(f"Waited: {ende - start >= 0.05}")
jetzt = datetime.now()
print(f"Hour valid: {0 <= jetzt.hour <= 23}")

tasks.instruction: Measure the waiting time with time.time() before and after time.sleep(0.2) and print exactly Waited long enough: True (difference at least 0.15).
Fetch the current time into now with from datetime import datetime. Print exactly Hour valid: True (0 to 23) and on the next line Year has 4 digits: True (len(now.strftime("%Y")) == 4).

validation.expected:
Hour valid: True
Year has 4 digits: True

title: Archive Spell 6: math and calculation operators
lessonSummary: Strong at maths! You use math, powers, remainder and whole-number division.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: math functions and the three operators.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import math
print(f"Root: {math.sqrt(16)}")
print(f"Rounded up: {math.ceil(3.2)}")
print(f"Power: {2 ** 3}")
print(f"Whole: {17 // 5}")
print(f"Remainder: {17 % 5}")

tasks.instruction: Calculate the circle area for radius 10 with math.pi * radius ** 2, round to 2 places and print exactly Area: 314.16.
Divide 17 by 5: Print exactly Whole: 3 (with //) and on the next line Remainder: 2 (with %).
Check with % whether the number 14 is even and print exactly 14 is even: True (number % 2 == 0).

title: Archive Spell 7: More math: factorial, gcd and primes
lessonSummary: Masterful! You combine math, functions, loops and the remainder operator.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: factorial, gcd, lcm and sin.
tasks.codeTemplate:
import math
print(f"Factorial: {math.factorial(5)}")
print(f"GGT: {math.gcd(24, 36)}")
print(f"KGV: {math.lcm(12, 15)}")
print(f"Sine: {round(math.sin(math.radians(90)), 1)}")

tasks.instruction: Use math to calculate the factorial of 6 and the greatest common divisor of 48 and 18. Print exactly Factorial: 720 and on the next line GCD: 6.
Write a function is_prime(n) like in the example above (with for and %). Print exactly 17: True and on the next line 18: False (with is_prime(17) and is_prime(18)).
